scope: Independent official-metadata and source-only native-prefix setup review; no target acquisition or execution
outline: Read root task/standards/R2, preserved host evidence and canonical driver owners.
Independently check official supported Debian13 amd64 package channel and exact authenticated metadata chain; no runtime/package payload acquisition.
Review full dependency/loader/extension/config/driver closure and whether artifact-only extraction into an owned prefix is actually supported and viable in the selected host.
Audit exact author freeze, proposed paths/actions/time/bytes/cost/cleanup and no initdb/service/security side effects; return precise ACCEPT_SOURCE/HOLD and external prerequisites.

criteria.expectation: Exact selected saved Debian13 amd64 host and PR18 source; no relocation or implicit installation/runtime authority.

Official supported channel with current exact version/architecture, retained metadata URLs/bytes/hashes, Release signature verification anchored to an independently established trusted key. HTTPS/hash alone insufficient.

Complete exact server/admin/client/native dependency closure, alternatives/version constraints and already-present host dependency evidence; mutable indices distinguished from admitted immutable inputs.

Official packaging/source proves extraction-only behavior and actual relocation/layout/loader/config/extension semantics for this build; dpkg-deb extraction syntax alone is not runtime-support evidence.
Required psycopg3.3.3 backend, selected Python and libpq/native closure plus pg8.23.1/Node24 closure fit actual canonical callers. Historical Windows lock is not reused as Linux evidence.

One exact bounded artifact-only setup recipe with verified paths, bytes/actions/resource/time/output/cost and ownership/rollback; no initdb/start/service/role/credentials/HBA/install scripts or global mutation.
No guessed support, isolation/auth exception or viable launcher claim. Unresolved external prerequisites are precise; stop speculative recipe expansion when support cannot be substantiated.

Exact clean author/evidence freeze, original failures retained, private bodies excluded, source acceptance distinct from setup/native approval; no target payload download/extraction/install/execute in review.
